description: Remove a declared third-party kit from a local game: its declaration, its entry in project.installed, its lock lines, the copy of its module beside the game and its kit module. GripForge's kits are not removed by this tool (gripforge_gamekit_remove). Guide: gripforge_docs { topic: "kit-third-party" }.

game.description: Absolute path of the game: its game.json ({ "project": …, "lock": … }), or the folder that holds it (an exported web game).

id.description: Id of the third-party kit, dotted, as its kit.json says (e.g. acme.streak).

modules.description: Absolute path of a folder of kit modules (kit-modules.json) to check against and to install the module in. Default: <game folder>/runtime-rust/kit-modules, else <game folder>/kit-modules, when present.

name: gripforge_third_party_kit_remove
title: Remove a third-party kit from a game
